fields.Name: IT15 - Remote Operations Over-The-Wire Progress
fields.Description: Over-the-wire RO-3 proof (CLIENT transport, needs a live MJAPI): a GraphQLDataProvider client calls RecordProcess.RunNow with an onProgress callback and asserts the typed RemoteOpProgress emitted server-side arrives over the RemoteOperationProgress GraphQL subscription (client subscribe → mutation → server emitProgress → PubSub → subscription → client onProgress). WIRE1 creates its fixtures over the wire (2 Action Categories + a FieldRules Record Process) and tears them down. Parked (seeded Skip) in the deterministic suite until MJAPI is provisioned in CI — exactly like IT03; the standalone dispatcher skips cleanly when MJAPI is unreachable.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: RunNow over the wire returns the run summary AND streams typed progress to the attached onProgress callback.
